objective: Define the canonical logical data-flow and storage architecture for NEXUS QUANT, including event-time semantics, immutable evidence, quality/provenance, feature lineage, replay, licensing-aware retention and recovery requirements without selecting concrete storage technologies.
scope: Define immutable raw evidence and licensing-aware retention rules
Define macro vintage and revision semantics
Define storage classes for reference data, trades, quotes, books, bars, events, features and audit evidence
Define operational state versus historical analytical state separation
Define replay manifests and deterministic reconstruction inputs
Define data deletion/retention behavior where provider rights require it
out_of_scope: Select concrete database, object storage, time-series engine, message bus or cloud vendor
Enable Demo, Shadow, Live or Auto Trading
tests: Every material event has source/provider provenance and time semantics
Raw evidence is immutable/versioned where retention rights permit
Provider retention/licensing constraints are represented explicitly
Operational mutable state is separated from immutable historical/replay evidence
Corrections/revisions never silently overwrite prior observed truth
Replay manifest can identify exact dataset/schema/config/model versions
Feature/evidence outputs retain lineage to source versions
No concrete database/message-bus/cloud technology is selected
Country/location is absent from data architecture assumptions
security_tests: Sensitive credentials are not stored in market-data datasets
Access class is explicit for raw/provider-restricted/audit data
Audit evidence is append-only/tamper-evident by design
Deletion/retention obligations can be enforced without corrupting audit references
evidence: P02-B domain boundaries and ownership matrix
rollback: Revert P02-C architecture artifacts and state/catalog changes. No runtime storage or provider resources are created.
definition_of_done: Logical storage classes and ownership are canonical
Task Catalog and Current State are reconciled
